messages.author: Petter Lindgren
messages.text: Analyser 3's operational qualification lapsed on the 1st — routine runs only this week. Analyser 1 is the quarterly proficiency panel both windows Thursday — steering-protected, not movable without Wanjiru.

messages.author: Réka Varga
messages.text: Control side is fine: lot 2201 (4 vials) is released and covers the 3-plate run; 2188 is inside the dating horizon and does not count. The restock afterwards is on SO-88301.

messages.author: Petter Lindgren
messages.text: If anyone floats an evening extension to squeeze it into Thursday, that is a separate request to me. Nothing approved yet.
